item.title: Ariana Grande Reschedules Three Eternal Sunshine Tour Dates
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey, music lovers! Welcome to the latest update on Billboard's trending news. Ariana Grande has just announced some changes to her Eternal Sunshine Tour due to production issues that raised safety concerns. Let's dive into the details."
[Short musical transition]
Host: "Ariana Grande has rescheduled three dates on her tour. The July 12 show at Barclays Center in Brooklyn will now take place on July 14, and her July 22 and July 24 concerts at TD Garden in Boston have been moved to July 23 and July 26, respectively. Grande apologized to fans on Instagram, explaining that safety is the top priority and these changes ensure the show can be presented as planned."
[Short musical transition]
Host: "The good news is that all tickets will be honored for the rescheduled dates, and ticket holders will receive more information directly. The Eternal Sunshine Tour, which supports Grande's seventh studio album, has been a massive success so far, with a setlist that spans her entire catalog, including hits from Positions, Dangerous Woman, and thank u, next."
[Short musical transition]
Host: "And if you're excited about new music from Ariana Grande, you won't have to wait long! Her eighth studio album, Petal, is set to drop on July 31, led by the hit single 'Hate That I Made You Love Me,' which recently became her 10th career No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100. That's all for now. Stay tuned for more music updates, and thanks for listening!"
[Outro music plays]
